dedupe_keys.name: liguria waste facility and landfill siting criteria 20212026 plan

description: Region of Liguria publishes geospatial exclusion, penalty and preferred-location criteria for waste-treatment plants, landfills and transfer stations under the regional waste-management plan 2021–2026. The nine thematic layers each have dataset, download-service and viewing-service metadata. Coverage is Liguria. The criteria provide spatial constraints for capacity planning and optimisation of waste-management infrastructure. The grouped resource has 27 native metadata entries; versions, map sheets and complementary representations are retained together where the provider defines the same resource. The metadata permits public access and states a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 licence. Metadata is publicly readable; charges for obtaining or using the underlying material are not established here. Access is through the linked native metadata, which lists the provider routes and declared formats. Some preferred-criteria titles repeat a penalty-criteria abstract. The separate title roles are retained; thresholds, legal validity and the policy PDF were not inspected. Accuracy and current completeness remain unverified. No distribution, map, feature or document body was downloaded. Descriptive metadata dates range from 2023-12-18 to 2023-12-18; these dates are not treated as asset observation dates. Related regional or municipal inventories describe other physical assets or broader source catalogues.
